text:
Asha: quick feed from last night's zephyr-mini-int4 onboarding run vs structured-invoke harness. Parse failures ~1.6% — mostly truncated closing brace when model streams a short prose suffix (e.g., 'done.' after JSON).

Leo: can you paste a raw snippet?

Asha: captured: ```
{
  "action": "get_user",
  "params": {"id": "u-42"}
}
done.
``` parser chokes because of trailing text.

Samir: two lightweight mitigations: 1) balanced-extractor that finds first complete JSON object and ignores trailing chars; 2) immediate retry with temp=0.0 and instruction 'ONLY return JSON'. Start with extractor (cheap) and add retry only if extractor fails.

Leo: extractor ok but add a safety check: accept only if top-level keys match expected set (action, params, meta). Log clipped examples for manual review.

Asha: plan: 8k AB test: A=baseline, B=extractor+schema-check, C=B+one retry. Metrics: parse rate, semantic match, false-accept (extractor clipped useful text), latency p95, token delta.

deploy-bot: job queued: "zephyr-mini-int4-struct-8k" ETA ~30m :rocket:

Samir: I'll add sampling for clipped examples (100 per run) and a small decoder probe that tweaks punctuation logits on a 1k slice.

Asha: thanks — will post results and example dump when run completes. :coffee:
